Already WGS84 - this source needs no registration, which is why it outranks every fitted sheet here. `canon` records how a feature should be treated, NOT whether it was imported: everything is imported.
label: Former faction territories
creator: u/Sparky_321, extending u/MarcelusWalrus

properties.name: Twin Mothers Territory (Formerly)
properties.note: The Twin Mothers were a matriarchal tribe known for creating a powerful morphine-like medicine called bitter drink. At some point prior to 2281, they were absorbed or destroyed by Caesar's Legion.

properties.name: Brotherhood Outcasts (Formerly)
properties.note: The Brotherhood Outcasts are a splinter faction of the Brotherhood of Steel that broke ties with Elder Lyons’ group at the Citadel. The Outcasts attribute their departure to their belief that Elder Lyons had lost sight of the Brotherhood’s true mission and the original reason for their presence in the Capital Wasteland: the recovery and preservation of advanced pre-War technology. Dissatisfied with Lyons’ focus on aiding the local peoples of the Capital Wasteland, a contingent of Brotherhood members led by Henry Casdin absconded from the Citadel in the dead of night, taking weapons and advanced technologies with them. Led by Casdin, the dissidents traveled north and eventually took up residence at Fort Independence.

properties.name: The Last Son of Atom's Children of Atom sect (Formerly)
Sun Dog Territory (Formerly)
properties.note: The Sun Dogs were a post-war tribe. They were conquered by Caesar’s Legion and forcibly assimilated, which the Legionary Dead Sea took part in. ** Depicted territory is speculated. **

properties.name: Crazy Horns (Formerly)
properties.note: The Crazy Horns were a tribe that received help from New Canaanite missionaries. They were taken advantage of by prospectors, slavers, and raiders, and eventually wiped out. ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Tar Walkers (Formerly)
properties.note: The Tar Walkers were a tribe that received help from New Canaanite missionaries. They were taken advantage of by prospectors, slavers, and raiders, and eventually wiped out. ** Depicted location is speculated, though their name implies that they may have been located near one of Utah's tar sands. **

properties.note: Update May 2026 - I'm adding Pulowski Preservation Shelters because why not? Also, I've finally begun playing Fallout 76, so that portion of the map will finally be updated in earnest. Update April 2026 - I'm starting to add the estimated vault locations from the map in the TV show. Update March 2026 - I've started adding bomb craters visible in Tactics. Thank you to u/Nuclear_Rabbit on Reddit for first mapping these. See: https://www.reddit.com/r/Fallout/comments/1f6dvgl/i_matched_the_fallout_tactics_map_to_google_earth/ Update January 2026 - I have decided to integrate the TV show locations into the main location list and the original TV show tab now only consists of known factions and their statuses in 2296. It is separate from the other faction tab, which runs up to 2287. These two tabs are intended to be used one at a time; close one then open the other, or vise-versa. Also, regarding the map in the TV show's second season, I am using restraint taking info from it, as the showrunners directly ripped it from a fan-made map without double-checking what they were doing. The only parts I am adding into my map are the faction territories, as these were intentionally designed and not copied.
